rows.title: Pretty good idler
rows.body: I mean for an idler game it actually grabbed my attention, hard to do. These kinds of games usually don’t appeal to me but this one’s fun art and story got me. And I think it runs smoothly so far just beat the first boss. Only downside to it for my phone is text size, like for it to be a wee bit easier to read. But if you’re looking for a neat lil idler this is it.

rows.title: Fire ngl
rows.body: Game is just fun and chill, I’m never short of content. It can be both slow and fast depending on your play style I can always be busy and spend my free time nicely with this game. It’s so chill I play it with my buddies when they come over.

rows.title: Progress too slow
rows.body: Takes days to make any progress. I’d recommend Blade Idle instead. In the same time it took me to clear 5 chapters in Moon Rabbit, I cleared over 30 chapters in Blade Idle. There are also about a million IAPs in this game. Clearly they want you to feel progress is too slow so you buy something to speed it up. Shady.

rows.title: Opinion
rows.body: It’s super good and I love it, but I can’t enter gift codes and stuff because the button is simply not there, I am new so maybe they got rid of codes and stuff recently but idk

rows.title: So relaxing and fun game
rows.body: This game is so chill and fun, you can kill your time and always have something to do everyday. For the Ruby, u can keep playing, dont need to pay for win. Perfect game !!!

rows.title: for an afk game??
rows.body: i think it’s great,it’s pretty and they’re generous with the in game currencies for the time being. my main reason for giving five stars was because i’ve never seen a game with performance options like this one. plenty of options to turn down/off to help it run better on devices that might not be able to handle it. that’s sick.

rows.title: So funnn
rows.body: Me and my friends have been playing this sooo much I would recommend this to anyone that like idle rpgs this one is not boring it is new a fun.😊

rows.title: Bugs
rows.body: Good game but I tried opening it after getting off for a bit now it keeps freezing on the loading screen smh now I can’t even play it

rows.title: ThE BEST GAME
rows.body: this is top tier! I played this 3 years ago but my account disappeared but I’m still willing to redo the game! :>
